O RDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-3,
Community Shopping District, symbols and indications, as shown on Map No. 10-D in the
area bound by:

       South Ellis Avenue; East 41St Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Ellis
       Avenue; and, a line 12 feet north of East 41st Street to a point 78.7 feet north of East 41st
       Street

to those of a RM5, Residential Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective upon its passage and publication.




                                                             Lamont Robinson
                                                             Alderman, 4th Ward




Common Address:
4062 South Ellis Avenue
